profile.summary: Statistics and Data Science student at Strathmore University building practical data analysis and machine learning projects using Python. Interested in turning data into meaningful insights that support informed decision-making.
profile.tagline: Turning Data into Insights, Solutions, Decisions

achievements: Developed a Customer Churn Prediction System using Python and Scikit-learn, applying machine learning techniques to predict customer churn, evaluate model performance, and deploy an interactive Streamlit application.

Built a Student Performance Analysis Project using Python to explore academic performance data, identify patterns, and communicate findings through exploratory data analysis and visualizations.
Developed a House Price Prediction Project using Python and Scikit-learn, applying decision tree regression and data preprocessing techniques to estimate property prices from housing characteristics.
experience: BSc. Statistics and Data Science coursework projects; individual and group projects and assignments
